svg.title: iPadOS · Interval grading viewer · keyframed · Light › High · Wh · landscape
svg.desc: Mirrors the iPad LANDSCAPE editor (a regular-width window wider than tall): App/PhotoViewerView.swift `floatingEditorBody(in:)` — `floatingPictureFrame(in:)` anchors the picture top-left at the size its aspect gives it inside the safe area (a tall picture fills the height, a wide one the width); `touchChrome(showsBadge:)` puts the 36 pt back disc (and, on an interval shoot, the INTERVAL chip — App/EditorControls/EditorMarqueeBadge.swift) top-left and App/EditorControls/EditorTabPill.swift top-right, both 12 pt under the status bar; `floatingFootRow` seats App/EditorControls/EditorGroupBar.swift (`.padPill`, six 58 pt cells) bottom-right and, with a timeline, the compact App/GradeTimelineView.swift strip in a 66 pt capsule bottom-left, both 16 pt off the safe area's foot; `floatingPanel(in:)` floats App/PhotoAdjustmentsPanel.swift (`layout: .floating`, `style: .dark`) as a 400 pt card at right 16 / bottom 96 — above the buttons — draggable by its header (grab bar + title row, `floatingHeaderDragged`, clamped on screen by `clampedFloatingOffset`, the seat kept across groups for the session) and pinned top 62 / bottom 96 when the group is Presets. Pinch, double-tap and trackpad zoom release the picture from its anchor (≤ 1.03× snaps home; a '2.5× · tap to fit' pill then follows the back disc) — desc-only here. iPad PORTRAIT is NOT this layout and not the phone's either: it takes the dark rail (`railBody`, settled 2026-09-13 over spec decision 9), undrawn. Tokens: ground #000, chrome rgba(28,28,30,.85–.86) over .ultraThinMaterial, amber #FFB340 for every highlight, #8E8E93 secondary, diamond #FFB340 with a #C36A00 ring. Geometry measured on an iPad Pro 11-inch (M4) simulator (1210×834 pt) on 2026-09-13 and carried to this 1180×820 canvas: left- and top-anchored positions transfer, trailing ones sit 30 pt further left and foot ones 14 pt higher here; the simulator's safe area is 24 top / 25 bottom, this canvas assumes 24 / 20. THIS FILE is board 6b: an INTERVAL shoot with a grade timeline (`hasTimeline`). A 16:9 picture fills the 1180 pt width at 663.75 pt tall from the safe area's top; the INTERVAL · 2 h 14 min · 58 frames chip follows the back disc. The strip — GradeTimelineView(compact: true) plus the two frame-step discs — sits in the 66 pt capsule from x 16 to 18 pt short of the buttons pill; three moments at 10 / 52 / 86 % (LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset), 0:00:00 / 2:14:00 under the track. DRAWN WITH THE PLAYHEAD SNAPPED ON THE SECOND MOMENT (52 %, bubble 1:09:41): the moment swells to 15 pt with a white ring and a 1.5 pt accent halo — treatment 1e-A's 'editing this moment' state — and the pad reads that moment's values. NOTE the hook itself parks the playhead at 30 %, between the first two moments and unsnapped, which is how the 2026-09-13 screenshot (screens/ipad-light-highwhites.png) reads: bubble 0:14 on a 43 s shoot and Highlights −27; everything else in that capture matches this drawing. Light › High · Wh open: all three chips carry the diamond because the hook's scenario moves exposure, highlights AND shadows (the board only keyframes exposure, highlights and Temp); the pad is #3A3A3E → #C8C8CC bottom to top with Lift / Recover / Whites − / Whites +, the knob 35 % of the half-height below the crosshair; readouts Highlights ◆ −35 (amber, keyframed) and Whites 0 (amber — the dark editors' value colour, keyframed or not). Readouts print the app's existing formats — an ASCII hyphen-minus, as every mirror in this repository draws — where the boards typeset U+2212. Buttons pill: Light open (amber 14 %), dots on Presets (Natural, edited), Light and Color (the owned white). Same card geometry as the photo file. Staged by LL_EDITOR=latest LL_VIEWER=1 LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=light:highwhites on an iPad Pro 11-inch simulator (the largest interval shoot in the library; the capture session seeded a 36-frame 16:9 project with LL_IMPORT_STILLS). The video editor (App/VideoEditorView.swift) draws this same layout over the movie's own clock — undrawn.
svg.text: iPadOS · Interval grading viewer · keyframed · Light › High · Wh · landscape · 1180×820 pt
mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift floatingEditorBody + GradeTimelineView (compact) + PhotoAdjustmentsPanel (.floating) — board 6b · LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=light:highwhites
